n308ffe2973.headline: Albert will increase wages by one fifth. Employees will also receive shopping vouchers | Aktuálně.cz
n308ffe2973.summary: Albert announced a base salary increase of 7% from January, with total wage growth including bonuses reaching 20%, plus shopping vouchers for employees.
n308ffe2973.why: Wage increases in retail can affect labor costs, consumer spending, and competitive positioning in the sector.
